articles.summary: Hecla Mining Company (NYSE: HL) today announced that it has called for redemption of all the outstanding shares of its Series B Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock (NYSE: HL-PB) (the "Series B Preferred Stock"). The redemption will take place on December 11, 2026 (the "Redemption Date"). Redemption Terms Redemption Price. Each share outstanding on the Redemption Date will be redeemed for $50.00 plus all accrued and unpaid dividends up to the Redemption Date, paid in cash. Accrued dividends from October 1, 2026, the most recent dividend payment date, will be $0.6806 per share, for a total redemption price of $50.6806 per share. Dividends. The accrued dividend is included in the redemption price and will be paid with the redemption price on surrender of the shares, rather than to holders as of a dividend record date. Hecla does not expect to declare another regular quarterly dividend on the Series B Preferred Stock before the Redemption Date. Dividends end. Dividends on the Series B
articles.title: Hecla Mining Company Announces Redemption of All Outstanding Shares of Its Series B Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock
